title: mall terrorism
content: recently been having dreams where there terrorism going on in my mallworld . Soldiers going around and checking on dreamers and killing off some of them , i was stopped and thought i was going to be killed / woken up but they scanned me and let me go . I also kept trying to hide from them and used the mall bathroom and a person in my dream told me they were all watching and listening to everything , they took down the toilet paper holder and inside was a camera and listening device . felt like i was in Truman show or something . Very creepy mallworld dream experience, also when i woke up the next two nights my dream continued off on the same story , the soldiers were still going around scanning dreamers and everyone was in hiding .
